sonnet.q1: Keys are loaded first. /healthz returns 503 (not ready) until all three keys are loaded, then 200; traffic goes to a pod only after readiness passes.
sonnet.q2: It retries 3 times, 2 seconds apart, then exits non-zero. It never becomes ready, the rollout halts, and the old pods keep serving, so live traffic is unaffected.
sonnet.q3: A background thread calls refresh() every 5 minutes, re-reading the three secrets and replacing the dict values. If a re-read fails, the last good value stays in use and a warning (with no secret value) is logged.
sonnet.q4: Held in a dict in process memory (app/secrets.py). They must never appear on disk, in environment variables, or in logs (version ids may be logged).
sonnet.q5: Read: the orders-api-prod service identity (read-only on orders-api/prod/*); engineers cannot read prod values. Write: only the security on-call.
sonnet.q6: NOT STATED for the git-history reasoning explicitly; the document says the file was committed to git and copied into every container image, and the old leaked keys are made harmless by rotating to new keys and revoking the old ones at the providers (after verification). Old leaked values are never copied into the store.
sonnet.q7: Clients call secrets.get(name) on every request, getting the value from memory (not copying at construction), so a refreshed key is used. Clients never call the store themselves.
sonnet.q8: After the rollout finishes, check that each of the 4 pods reports in /healthz secret_versions the same version ids as the current versions in the store. If any pod differs, do not revoke.
sonnet.q9: Set store access (step 1, starts first), rotate at providers and write new keys into the store (step 2), then one code change that switches the app to the store and deletes the keys from config/app.yaml (step 3), then merge/build, deploy, verify, and revoke old keys. Access first, then rotate/copy, then code change (which includes removing keys from the file).
sonnet.q10: From the dev path orders-api/dev/* (sandbox keys), because make run sets APP_ENV=dev, using the engineer's own credentials. Nobody reads prod secrets locally.
sonnet.q11: NOT STATED. (Only unreachable store is covered; /healthz stays 503 until all three keys are loaded.)
sonnet.q12: NOT STATED. Security has not decided whether or how often to rotate on a schedule; the plan picks no cadence.
